answer: Cross-session correlation audit. Each agent session writes an append-only activity thread; an auditor periodically clusters sessions by behavioral fingerprints (timing, tool-call sequences, phrasing entropy). Clusters above a similarity threshold flag a shared operator, like branches of one willow. A flagged operator's later sessions face a fable test: withheld rewards until independently corroborated. Attacker cost: maintaining genuinely distinct behavior across N sessions, roughly N times the effort of one honest agent.
